gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.wings_in: Spread the wings (Jump in the air to flap)
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.cleanse_re: Tears symbiotes off everything near (%s satiety)
gui.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.steed_in: Let it into the horse you ride
item.jaymospowers.jarred_symbiote.hint: Use it to let it back in.
Not yet. We are not so far in you that we can carry you.
Up, then. We will hold the air.
Wide. Wider than a house. Look at what we are.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.jar.st: That bell... it goes through every thought. We cannot hold. We cannot hold you.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.jar.re: We are back. We remember the glass in your hand. Do not do that again.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.jar.po: Glass. You waited for the bell, with glass in your hand, and poured us out like water. We will not forget it.
You rang us hollow and shut us in a jar. We trusted you less each hour, and now not at all.
The bell, and then the jar. That is not how we are parted. We hate it. We hate you for it.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.jar.ba: You. The hand that held the glass. We are in, and we remember.
The jar was a cold place. You put us there. You open it now, and think that is kind.
Back in the warm. We have not forgiven the bell.
Not the hand that held the glass. We remember that one. Who are you?
A stranger opens the jar. We go in, because we must. We trust nothing.
Another host. The first is not forgotten, and neither is the bell.
message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.cleans: Pale. Pale. Go out of them.
Not yet. We are still thin from the last.
We have nothing to spend. Feed us.
Something pale tears us out. It burns. We are not going back.
The beast. Yes. We reach down into it.
It is ours now, while we hold it. It will not throw you.
We let the beast go. It shakes itself.
There is nothing under you to reach into.
We cannot eat for two. We let it go.
You left it. We loosen. It is only a horse again.
